Automations.title: Automations
Automations.body: Automations shows every rule this workspace runs unattended, and every single run. Under rules you define triggers, conditions and actions; the history shows what a rule actually did, including when something went wrong. Deactivating is always possible, regardless of your role, so a misbehaving rule can be stopped at once.
